snippet.title: CORDURA - Official Gameplay Trailer Reveal
snippet.description:
"It's a simple job, for men with nerve."

CORDURA is a quota-based, co-op survival horror game with premium AA quality where the darkness listens, learns, and mimics your friends’ voices to break your squad's sanity.

Watch the first-ever gameplay reveal and see how paranoia dictates every second of the run. Deep inside decaying Victorian mansions, your objective is clear: infiltrate, secure the quota, and secure the "Roses of the Night" before the night claims your mind.

But in these halls, silence is your only shield, and communication is a trap. Our unique Mimic System uses proximity voice chat to record and imitate the actual voices and appearances of your teammates—making you question whether that call for help on the radio is your friend, or the night wanting to kill you.

WISHLIST CORDURA NOW:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4414560
PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018727/

KEY FEATURES:

- Tactical Co-op Horror Quota (1-4 Players): Venture into procedural labyrinths alone or with up to 3 friends. The threat scales with your squad size.
- The Mimic System: Experience true paranoia as the environment records your in-game conversations, using your allies' real voices and faces against you.
- High-Stakes Tactical Maze Gameplay: Coordination is key. Work together with your teammates to fulfill the corporation's strict quota, guide each other via maps or radio, and find your way out of the maze alive.
- Premium AA Atmosphere & Insanity: Explore beautifully dark, high-visual quality environments where the labyrinth corrupts and lights dynamically shift around you. As your sanity drops, your mind will play tricks on you—making you see shadows that aren't there and hear voices that don't exist.
- Permadeath: Every worker is an expendable asset. If a worker falls to the entity, they are gone, but you can hire a new one and continue with the incursions.
